headlines.title: American Express (AXP) Names Sarah Dodds Brown As Legal Chief After Laureen Seeger Retirement
headlines.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) announced a leadership change as Chief Legal Officer Laureen Seeger retires after a long tenure. Sarah Dodds-Brown has been appointed to succeed Seeger as Chief Legal Officer, overseeing legal and governance functions. The transition shifts responsibility for legal, regulatory and governance matters from Seeger to Dodds-Brown within the American Express executive team.

headlines.title: California business owner thought he was getting $750K — instead he got a 'long nightmare' that cost him thousands
headlines.summary: Vahe Shahinian says a broker dangled a cheap $750,000 credit line. Seven years later, he's lost his home, moved back in with his parents and is still fighting in court.

headlines.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
headlines.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.

description: American Express Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated payments company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and internationally. It operates through four segments: U.S. Consumer Services, Commercial Services, International Card Services, and Global Merchant and Network Services. The company offers credit and charge cards and complementary products and services, including travel, dining, and lifestyle and expense management products and services; and banking and other payment and financing products and services, including deposits and non-card lending. It also provides merchant acquisition and processing, servicing and settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing and information products and services, as well as network services. The company offers its products and services to consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies, and large corporations through mobile and online applications, affiliate marketing, customer referral programs, third-party service providers and business partners, in-house sales teams, direct mail, telephone, and direct response advertising. American Express Company was founded in 1850 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
